content: Geospatial/engineering firms (Fugro, Trimble, Axim Geospatial, Glanville Geospatial) structure case studies with: client/sector, challenge, method/technology used, and measurable outcome. Fugro links case studies directly from expertise pages (e.g. site-characterisation-revolution-wind-fugro). Trimble features a single flagship customer story on the homepage (Lima Airport Partners) rather than a dense grid.
